name: Heidi Hadley
reason: Health restore, re-checked 12 Nov 2026 under the new rule: pain-relief wording alone would now pass, but her work is out of scope rather than out on health. Total Somatics (totalsomatics.com, robots.txt allows us) is an online membership in clinical somatic movement education after Thomas Hanna, sold on reducing pain, improving posture and mobility (site title 'Somatic Movement for Pain Relief'; YouTube @totalsomatics, 7,900 subscribers, Data API 12 Nov 2026, is mostly sub-minute Shorts on pandiculation, mobility and posture). It is movement education and body therapy, not a spiritual or contemplative practice; her 'somatic mindfulness' and body-scan pages are part of the same movement programme, and the site is a script-built app whose text can't be read without running it, so no listing could be built on the contemplative strand alone.
